description: VYBE Music v4.1.9 - Listen Together Smooth Audio Sync, YouTube Mix & Radio Playlist Importer with Blank-Screen Prevention, Spotify Liked Songs Library Sync, and Seamless In-App Updates.
changelog: Listen Together Audio Glitch Fix: Replaced aggressive 1-second hard seeks with smooth micro-speed adjustments (1.03x/0.97x) to eliminate all audio breaking, stuttering, and buffer drops for room guests
Buffered Drift Protection: Hard seeks are strictly rate-limited and suppressed during buffering to prevent audio choppiness
Optimized Room Heartbeat: Relaxed host sync heartbeat to 3000ms to prevent network flooding and audio conflicts
YouTube Mix & Radio Playlist Importer: Full import compatibility for YouTube Music radio and mix links (RD/RDGM series)
Blank Screen Prevention: Solved the empty playlist screen glitch by automatically resolving queue endpoints and providing clean empty placeholders
Smart Video ID Extraction: Automatically captures starting track video IDs from shared mix URLs for precision playback starts
Spotify Liked Songs Library Sync: Injected proper Spotify collection URI into GraphQL query variables, ensuring full access to user library tracks
Spotify Direct Liked Songs Import: Paste collection/tracks links directly into the importer for instant liked song extraction
Seamless In-App Updates: Removed redundant re-install buttons on latest version, ensuring smooth in-app OTA updates without reinstall confusion
